description: Non-parametric classifier that assigns a clause the majority label of its k nearest training neighbours in feature space. Distance metric and weighting scheme are tuned.
why_tested: End-semester addition; tests whether similarity-based retrieval of previously seen risky clauses is effective for this task.
input_features: Dense TruncatedSVD (100 components, training-fold fitted) of word unigram/bigram TF-IDF.
selection_rule: Max mean macro F1 on fixed group-respecting CV folds (development data only)
artifact_note: Fitted development pipeline saved to models/knn/artifacts/{protocol}/ (model.joblib + svd.joblib + metadata.json). Inference requires storing all training vectors, so prediction cost grows with training size.
